items.question: Trong câu "Some pay late, some catch up, and a few stop paying for good.", từ "catch up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some pay late, some catch up, and a few stop paying for good.", what does "catch up" (phrase) mean?
options: trả bù phần còn thiếu để theo kịp lịch
bắt kịp tin tức mới nhất
trả trước hạn toàn bộ khoản vay
optionsEn: to pay what was missed and get back on schedule
to repay the whole loan early
items.explanation: catch up /kætʃ ʌp/ (cụm từ): trả bù phần còn thiếu để theo kịp lịch. "Catch up on payments" = trả bù các kỳ đã lỡ.
items.explanationEn: catch up /kætʃ ʌp/ (phrase): to pay what was missed and get back on schedule. "Catch up on payments" = pay the installments you missed.

items.question: Trong câu "Some pay late, some catch up, and a few stop paying for good.", từ "for good" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some pay late, some catch up, and a few stop paying for good.", what does "for good" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: for good /fə ˈɡʊd/ (cụm từ): mãi mãi, vĩnh viễn. "Stop paying for good" = ngừng trả hẳn, không quay lại nữa.
items.explanationEn: for good /fə ˈɡʊd/ (phrase): permanently, forever. "Stop paying for good" = stop paying and never resume.

items.question: Trong câu "Chị Lan opens the VayNhanh app, asks for 12 million VND over 12 months, passes eKYC, gets an automatic decision in a few minutes, accepts the offer, receives the money and then pays a fixed amount every month.", từ "offer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Chị Lan opens the VayNhanh app, asks for 12 million VND over 12 months, passes eKYC, gets an automatic decision in a few minutes, accepts the offer, receives the money and then pays a fixed amount every month.", what does "offer" (noun) mean?
options: chương trình khuyến mãi giảm giá
hồ sơ khách nộp để xin vay
đề nghị cho vay (số tiền, lãi, kỳ hạn) gửi cho khách
optionsEn: the loan terms proposed to the customer
items.explanation: offer /ˈɒf.ər/ (danh từ): đề nghị cho vay (số tiền, lãi, kỳ hạn) gửi cho khách. "Accept / decline an offer" = nhận / từ chối đề nghị cho vay.
items.explanationEn: offer /ˈɒf.ər/ (noun): the loan terms proposed to the customer. "Accept / decline an offer" = take or refuse the proposed loan.

items.question: Trong câu "Applications jumped in March–April and the approval rate climbed from about 51% to about 53–57% from March to June.", từ "climb" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Applications jumped in March–April and the approval rate climbed from about 51% to about 53–57% from March to June.", what does "climb" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: climb /klaɪm/ (động từ): tăng lên dần. Dùng cho số liệu: "the rate climbed from X to Y".
items.explanationEn: climb /klaɪm/ (verb): to rise gradually. Used for figures: "the rate climbed from X to Y".

items.question: Trong câu "`kyc_failed` is a different kind of problem: the customer never got through identity checks, which is an onboarding issue for the product team rather than a credit decision.", từ "onboarding" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "`kyc_failed` is a different kind of problem: the customer never got through identity checks, which is an onboarding issue for the product team rather than a credit decision.", what does "onboarding" (noun) mean?
options: quy trình đưa khách mới vào dùng sản phẩm (đăng ký, eKYC)
việc lên máy bay hoặc tàu xe
đào tạo nhân viên mới vào công ty
thu hồi nợ khách hàng cũ
optionsEn: the process of getting a new customer set up
getting on a plane or train
items.explanation: onboarding /ˈɒnˌbɔː.dɪŋ/ (danh từ): quy trình đưa khách mới vào dùng sản phẩm (đăng ký, eKYC). Trong fintech, onboarding thường gồm đăng ký, eKYC và mở tài khoản.
items.explanationEn: onboarding /ˈɒnˌbɔː.dɪŋ/ (noun): the process of getting a new customer set up. In fintech, onboarding usually covers sign-up, eKYC and account opening.

items.question: Trong câu "An approval rate can rise because better customers arrived, or because the lender relaxed its rules.", từ "relax" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An approval rate can rise because better customers arrived, or because the lender relaxed its rules.", what does "relax" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: relax /rɪˈlæks/ (động từ): nới lỏng (quy định, tiêu chí). "Relax the criteria / the cut-off" = nới tiêu chí / hạ ngưỡng.
items.explanationEn: relax /rɪˈlæks/ (verb): to make rules less strict. "Relax the criteria / the cut-off" = loosen them.

items.question: Trong câu "Almost half of rejections are about affordability (DTI, section 9), a third about the credit score.", từ "affordability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Almost half of rejections are about affordability (DTI, section 9), a third about the credit score.", what does "affordability" (noun) mean?
options: mức độ uy tín thương hiệu
khả năng chi trả (của người vay)
optionsEn: whether the borrower can afford the payments
items.explanation: affordability /əˌfɔː.dəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): khả năng chi trả (của người vay). "Affordability check" = kiểm tra khả năng trả nợ, thường bằng DTI.
items.explanationEn: affordability /əˌfɔː.dəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): whether the borrower can afford the payments. "Affordability check" = testing whether payments fit income, often via DTI.

items.question: Trong câu "Almost half of rejections are about affordability (DTI, section 9), a third about the credit score.", từ "rejection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Almost half of rejections are about affordability (DTI, section 9), a third about the credit score.", what does "rejection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rejection /rɪˈdʒek.ʃən/ (danh từ): việc từ chối (hồ sơ vay). "Rejection reason" = lý do từ chối.
items.explanationEn: rejection /rɪˈdʒek.ʃən/ (noun): a refusal of an application. "Rejection reason" = why an application was refused.

items.question: Trong câu "The first is good news; the second only shows up months later, in repayments.", từ "show up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first is good news; the second only shows up months later, in repayments.", what does "show up" (phrase) mean?
options: lộ ra, xuất hiện (trong dữ liệu)
items.explanation: show up /ʃəʊ ʌp/ (cụm từ): lộ ra, xuất hiện (trong dữ liệu). "Show up in the data" = lộ ra trong số liệu.
items.explanationEn: show up /ʃəʊ ʌp/ (phrase): to become visible. "Show up in the data" = become visible in the numbers.

items.question: Trong câu "The first is good news; the second only shows up months later, in repayments.", từ "repayment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first is good news; the second only shows up months later, in repayments.", what does "repayment" (noun) mean?
options: việc trả nợ, khoản trả nợ
tiền hoàn lại khi trả hàng
optionsEn: money paid out to a borrower
items.explanation: repayment /rɪˈpeɪ.mənt/ (danh từ): việc trả nợ, khoản trả nợ. "Repayment schedule" = lịch trả nợ.
items.explanationEn: repayment /rɪˈpeɪ.mənt/ (noun): paying back a loan. "Repayment schedule" = the plan of installments.

items.question: Trong câu "Hold that thought until section 7.", từ "hold that thought" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hold that thought until section 7.", what does "hold that thought" (phrase) mean?
options: hãy nói to ý đó ra
khoan đã, giữ ý đó lại để bàn sau
optionsEn: keep that idea in mind for later
items.explanation: hold that thought /həʊld ðæt θɔːt/ (cụm từ): khoan đã, giữ ý đó lại để bàn sau. Câu nói thân mật để tạm gác một ý, sẽ quay lại sau.
items.explanationEn: hold that thought /həʊld ðæt θɔːt/ (phrase): keep that idea in mind for later. An informal way to pause an idea and come back to it.

items.question: Trong câu "It shrinks as customers repay and is the base for most risk ratios.", từ "shrink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It shrinks as customers repay and is the base for most risk ratios.", what does "shrink" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (động từ): giảm dần, co lại. Dư nợ "shrinks" khi khách trả gốc.
items.explanationEn: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (verb): to become smaller. The balance "shrinks" as principal is repaid.

items.question: Trong câu "In total VayNhanh has disbursed about 34.0 billion VND across 3,106 loans.", từ "disburse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In total VayNhanh has disbursed about 34.0 billion VND across 3,106 loans.", what does "disburse" (verb) mean?
options: phân tán, giải tán đám đông
items.explanation: disburse /dɪsˈbɜːs/ (động từ): giải ngân, chi tiền ra. Danh từ: disbursement = việc giải ngân.
items.explanationEn: disburse /dɪsˈbɜːs/ (verb): to pay out money. Noun: disbursement = the payout.

items.question: Trong câu "You cannot just add up unpaid installments: each installment mixes interest and principal (section 4), and unpaid future installments include interest that has not been earned yet.", từ "installment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You cannot just add up unpaid installments: each installment mixes interest and principal (section 4), and unpaid future installments include interest that has not been earned yet.", what does "installment" (noun) mean?
options: một tập của phim nhiều tập
kỳ trả góp, khoản trả mỗi kỳ
optionsEn: one of the regular payments of a loan
items.explanation: installment /ɪnˈstɔːl.mənt/ (danh từ): kỳ trả góp, khoản trả mỗi kỳ. "Monthly installment" = tiền trả góp hàng tháng (Anh-Anh: instalment).
items.explanationEn: installment /ɪnˈstɔːl.mənt/ (noun): one of the regular payments of a loan. "Monthly installment" = the monthly payment (British: instalment).

items.question: Trong câu "You cannot just add up unpaid installments: each installment mixes interest and principal (section 4), and unpaid future installments include interest that has not been earned yet.", từ "principal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You cannot just add up unpaid installments: each installment mixes interest and principal (section 4), and unpaid future installments include interest that has not been earned yet.", what does "principal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: principal /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (danh từ): tiền gốc của khoản vay. Đừng nhầm với "principle" (nguyên tắc), phát âm giống nhau.
items.explanationEn: principal /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (noun): the amount borrowed, excluding interest. Do not confuse with "principle" (a rule); they sound the same.

items.question: Trong câu "BNPL loans here are 0% for the customer (the merchant pays a fee instead, which is a payments topic).", từ "merchant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BNPL loans here are 0% for the customer (the merchant pays a fee instead, which is a payments topic).", what does "merchant" (noun) mean?
options: thương nhân buôn tàu biển thời xưa
người bán / đơn vị chấp nhận thanh toán
items.explanation: merchant /ˈmɜː.tʃənt/ (danh từ): người bán / đơn vị chấp nhận thanh toán. "Merchant fee / MDR" = phí người bán trả cho mỗi giao dịch.
items.explanationEn: merchant /ˈmɜː.tʃənt/ (noun): a business that accepts payments. "Merchant fee / MDR" = the fee the seller pays per payment.

items.question: Trong câu "Read it like this: early payments are mostly interest, later ones mostly principal, because interest is charged on a shrinking balance.", từ "balance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read it like this: early payments are mostly interest, later ones mostly principal, because interest is charged on a shrinking balance.", what does "balance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: balance /ˈbæl.əns/ (danh từ): số dư (nợ) còn lại. "Outstanding balance" = dư nợ còn lại.
items.explanationEn: balance /ˈbæl.əns/ (noun): the amount still owed. "Outstanding balance" = what is still owed.

items.question: Trong câu "The small negative at the end is the rounding-up of the installment; a real system would trim the last payment.", từ "trim" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The small negative at the end is the rounding-up of the installment; a real system would trim the last payment.", what does "trim" (verb) mean?
options: điều chỉnh giảm bớt một chút
optionsEn: to cut hair or a hedge
items.explanation: trim /trɪm/ (động từ): điều chỉnh giảm bớt một chút. "Trim the last payment" = giảm kỳ cuối cho khớp số dư.
items.explanationEn: trim /trɪm/ (verb): to reduce slightly. "Trim the last payment" = reduce it to match the balance.

items.question: Trong câu "A 12-month annuity at 24% costs much less than 24% of the principal in total interest, because the balance falls every month; a flat 2% a month costs exactly 24% and has a much higher APR.", từ "annuity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A 12-month annuity at 24% costs much less than 24% of the principal in total interest, because the balance falls every month; a flat 2% a month costs exactly 24% and has a much higher APR.", what does "annuity" (noun) mean?
options: khoản vay trả gốc một lần cuối kỳ
khoản vay trả góp đều mỗi kỳ (niên kim)
optionsEn: a loan repaid in one lump at the end
a loan repaid in equal regular payments
items.explanation: annuity /əˈnjuː.ə.ti/ (danh từ): khoản vay trả góp đều mỗi kỳ (niên kim). "Annuity formula" = công thức tính tiền trả đều mỗi kỳ.
items.explanationEn: annuity /əˈnjuː.ə.ti/ (noun): a loan repaid in equal regular payments. "Annuity formula" = the formula for an equal payment.

items.question: Trong câu "But because BNPL terms are only 3 or 6 months, those loans leave the book much faster than cash loans.", từ "term" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But because BNPL terms are only 3 or 6 months, those loans leave the book much faster than cash loans.", what does "term" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a word with a special meaning
items.explanation: term /tɜːm/ (danh từ): kỳ hạn (thời gian vay). "Term_months" = kỳ hạn tính bằng tháng.
items.explanationEn: term /tɜːm/ (noun): the length of a loan. "term_months" = loan length in months.

items.question: Trong câu "Two numbers are easy to mix up:", từ "mix up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two numbers are easy to mix up:", what does "mix up" (phrase) mean?
options: nhầm lẫn cái này với cái kia
optionsEn: to confuse one thing with another
items.explanation: mix up /mɪks ʌp/ (cụm từ): nhầm lẫn cái này với cái kia. "Easy to mix up" = dễ nhầm.
items.explanationEn: mix up /mɪks ʌp/ (phrase): to confuse one thing with another. "Easy to mix up" = easily confused.

items.question: Trong câu "The answer, for the 1,816 loans not yet closed: about 15.3 billion VND outstanding, less than half of everything ever disbursed.", từ "outstanding" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The answer, for the 1,816 loans not yet closed: about 15.3 billion VND outstanding, less than half of everything ever disbursed.", what does "outstanding" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: outstanding /aʊtˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): còn nợ, chưa thanh toán. "Outstanding principal" = dư nợ gốc.
items.explanationEn: outstanding /aʊtˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (adjective): still owed, not yet paid. "Outstanding principal" = principal still owed.

items.question: Trong câu "Installment 4 is unpaid but not yet due, so it is not overdue at all.", từ "overdue" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Installment 4 is unpaid but not yet due, so it is not overdue at all.", what does "overdue" (adjective) mean?
options: quá hạn (đã qua ngày đến hạn mà chưa trả)
items.explanation: overdue /ˌəʊ.vəˈdjuː/ (tính từ): quá hạn (đã qua ngày đến hạn mà chưa trả). "Overdue amount" = số tiền quá hạn.
items.explanationEn: overdue /ˌəʊ.vəˈdjuː/ (adjective): unpaid after the due date. "Overdue amount" = money past its due date.

items.question: Trong câu "Installment 4 is unpaid but not yet due, so it is not overdue at all.", từ "due" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Installment 4 is unpaid but not yet due, so it is not overdue at all.", what does "due" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: required to be paid by now
items.explanation: due /djuː/ (tính từ): đến hạn phải trả. "Due date" = ngày đến hạn; "not yet due" = chưa đến hạn.
items.explanationEn: due /djuː/ (adjective): required to be paid by now. "Due date" = payment deadline; "not yet due" = deadline not reached.

items.question: Trong câu "Collections teams work by bucket (a reminder SMS for 1–30, calls for 31–60, field visits or agencies later).", từ "collections" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Collections teams work by bucket (a reminder SMS for 1–30, calls for 31–60, field visits or agencies later).", what does "collections" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the work of recovering late payments
items.explanation: collections /kəˈlek.ʃənz/ (danh từ): hoạt động thu hồi nợ. "Collections team / agency" = đội / đơn vị thu hồi nợ.
items.explanationEn: collections /kəˈlek.ʃənz/ (noun): the work of recovering late payments. "Collections team / agency" = people who chase late payments.

items.question: Trong câu "With an inner `JOIN`, every current loan would vanish.", từ "vanish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With an inner `JOIN`, every current loan would vanish.", what does "vanish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: vanish /ˈvæn.ɪʃ/ (động từ): biến mất. Trong SQL: dòng "vanish" khi JOIN không tìm thấy dòng khớp.
items.explanationEn: vanish /ˈvæn.ɪʃ/ (verb): to disappear. In SQL, rows "vanish" when a JOIN finds no match.

items.question: Trong câu "Note the numerator: the whole outstanding balance of a late loan, not only its overdue installments, because once a customer is a month behind the whole balance is in danger.", từ "behind" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note the numerator: the whole outstanding balance of a late loan, not only its overdue installments, because once a customer is a month behind the whole balance is in danger.", what does "behind" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: behind /bɪˈhaɪnd/ (tính từ): chậm, nợ chưa trả kịp. "A month behind" = trễ một kỳ; "behind on payments" = chậm trả.
items.explanationEn: behind /bɪˈhaɪnd/ (adjective): late with payments. "A month behind" = one payment late.

items.question: Trong câu "If disbursements double, the denominator grows with fresh loans that cannot be late yet, and PAR30 falls even if no customer behaves better.", từ "denominator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If disbursements double, the denominator grows with fresh loans that cannot be late yet, and PAR30 falls even if no customer behaves better.", what does "denominator" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the number on top of a fraction
items.explanation: denominator /dɪˈnɒm.ɪ.neɪ.tər/ (danh từ): mẫu số. Đổi mẫu số là đổi ý nghĩa của tỷ lệ.
items.explanationEn: denominator /dɪˈnɒm.ɪ.neɪ.tər/ (noun): the number you divide by. Change the denominator and you change what a rate means.

items.question: Trong câu "The rules are set by a State Bank of Vietnam circular and are revised from time to time, so always check the circular currently in force before you build a report on them.", từ "circular" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The rules are set by a State Bank of Vietnam circular and are revised from time to time, so always check the circular currently in force before you build a report on them.", what does "circular" (noun) mean?
options: thông tư (văn bản hướng dẫn của cơ quan nhà nước)
luật do Quốc hội ban hành
items.explanation: circular /ˈsɜː.kjə.lər/ (danh từ): thông tư (văn bản hướng dẫn của cơ quan nhà nước). "A State Bank circular" = thông tư của Ngân hàng Nhà nước.
items.explanationEn: circular /ˈsɜː.kjə.lər/ (noun): an official regulatory document. "A State Bank circular" = a central-bank regulation.

items.question: Trong câu "The rules are set by a State Bank of Vietnam circular and are revised from time to time, so always check the circular currently in force before you build a report on them.", từ "in force" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The rules are set by a State Bank of Vietnam circular and are revised from time to time, so always check the circular currently in force before you build a report on them.", what does "in force" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in force /ɪn fɔːs/ (cụm từ): đang có hiệu lực. "Currently in force" = đang có hiệu lực.
items.explanationEn: in force /ɪn fɔːs/ (phrase): currently valid and applied. "Currently in force" = valid now.

items.question: Trong câu "The rules are set by a State Bank of Vietnam circular and are revised from time to time, so always check the circular currently in force before you build a report on them.", từ "revise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The rules are set by a State Bank of Vietnam circular and are revised from time to time, so always check the circular currently in force before you build a report on them.", what does "revise" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to issue for the first time
items.explanation: revise /rɪˈvaɪz/ (động từ): sửa đổi, điều chỉnh. "Revised from time to time" = thỉnh thoảng được sửa đổi.
items.explanationEn: revise /rɪˈvaɪz/ (verb): to change and update. "Revised from time to time" = updated now and then.

items.question: Trong câu "The lender writes a loan off when it judges the loan uncollectible, and charges the loss against the provision.", từ "uncollectible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The lender writes a loan off when it judges the loan uncollectible, and charges the loss against the provision.", what does "uncollectible" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: not worth collecting as a hobby
items.explanation: uncollectible /ˌʌn.kəˈlek.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): không thể thu hồi được. "Uncollectible debt" = nợ không đòi được.
items.explanationEn: uncollectible /ˌʌn.kəˈlek.tə.bəl/ (adjective): impossible to recover. "Uncollectible debt" = debt that cannot be recovered.

items.question: Trong câu "The lender writes a loan off when it judges the loan uncollectible, and charges the loss against the provision.", từ "write off" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The lender writes a loan off when it judges the loan uncollectible, and charges the loss against the provision.", what does "write off" (phrase) mean?
options: xóa nợ (đưa khoản vay khỏi sổ sách)
optionsEn: to remove a bad loan from the books
items.explanation: write off /raɪt ɒf/ (cụm từ): xóa nợ (đưa khoản vay khỏi sổ sách). Danh từ: a write-off = khoản xóa nợ.
items.explanationEn: write off /raɪt ɒf/ (phrase): to remove a bad loan from the books. Noun: a write-off.

items.question: Trong câu "A vintage table puts vintages in rows and MOB in columns, so every cell compares loans at the same age.", từ "cell" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A vintage table puts vintages in rows and MOB in columns, so every cell compares loans at the same age.", what does "cell" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a unit of a living body
items.explanation: cell /sel/ (danh từ): ô trong bảng. "Each cell compares..." = mỗi ô so sánh...
items.explanationEn: cell /sel/ (noun): one box in a table. "Each cell compares..." = each box in the grid compares.

items.question: Trong câu "The first installment falls due at MOB 1 and needs 31 more days to become 30+, so MOB 1 is always 0% and the table starts at MOB 2.", từ "fall due" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first installment falls due at MOB 1 and needs 31 more days to become 30+, so MOB 1 is always 0% and the table starts at MOB 2.", what does "fall due" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: fall due /fɔːl djuː/ (cụm từ): đến hạn phải trả. "The installment falls due on the 5th" = kỳ trả đến hạn ngày 5.
items.explanationEn: fall due /fɔːl djuː/ (phrase): to become payable. "The installment falls due on the 5th" = it must be paid then.

items.question: Trong câu "Data about young loans is right-censored: their future is cut off by the snapshot date.", từ "cut off" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data about young loans is right-censored: their future is cut off by the snapshot date.", what does "cut off" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: cut off /kʌt ɒf/ (cụm từ): cắt ngang, chặn lại. Động từ "cut off" khác danh từ "cut-off" (ngưỡng).
items.explanationEn: cut off /kʌt ɒf/ (phrase): to stop or interrupt. The verb "cut off" differs from the noun "cut-off" (threshold).

items.question: Trong câu "Both are illusions: May and June loans cannot be 30+ yet, and April has had one month less than March to go bad.", từ "illusion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are illusions: May and June loans cannot be 30+ yet, and April has had one month less than March to go bad.", what does "illusion" (noun) mean?
options: ảo giác, hình ảnh sai lệch
optionsEn: something that looks true but is not
items.explanation: illusion /ɪˈluː.ʒən/ (danh từ): ảo giác, hình ảnh sai lệch. "An illusion of improvement" = tưởng là cải thiện.
items.explanationEn: illusion /ɪˈluː.ʒən/ (noun): something that looks true but is not. "An illusion of improvement" = only looks better.

items.question: Trong câu "Compared at the same age, the two newest measurable vintages stand out: at MOB 2, March (3.2%) and April (4.1%) are above every vintage since July 2025; at MOB 3, March (7.4%) is more than double the usual level.", từ "stand out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Compared at the same age, the two newest measurable vintages stand out: at MOB 2, March (3.2%) and April (4.1%) are above every vintage since July 2025; at MOB 3, March (7.4%) is more than double the usual level.", what does "stand out" (phrase) mean?
options: nổi bật, khác hẳn phần còn lại
items.explanation: stand out /stænd aʊt/ (cụm từ): nổi bật, khác hẳn phần còn lại. "Stand out from the rest" = khác biệt rõ rệt.
items.explanationEn: stand out /stænd aʊt/ (phrase): to be clearly different. "Stand out from the rest" = be clearly different.

items.question: Trong câu "The deeper a loan sinks, the less likely it is to come back, which is why collections teams push hardest on the early buckets.", từ "sink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The deeper a loan sinks, the less likely it is to come back, which is why collections teams push hardest on the early buckets.", what does "sink" (verb) mean?
options: lún sâu hơn (vào nợ quá hạn)
items.explanation: sink /sɪŋk/ (động từ): lún sâu hơn (vào nợ quá hạn). "The deeper a loan sinks" = khoản vay càng trễ lâu.
items.explanationEn: sink /sɪŋk/ (verb): to go deeper into trouble. "The deeper a loan sinks" = the later it gets.

items.question: Trong câu "With these small counts (7, 20, 68 loans) treat one month as a hint; risk teams average roll rates over several months.", từ "hint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With these small counts (7, 20, 68 loans) treat one month as a hint; risk teams average roll rates over several months.", what does "hint" (noun) mean?
options: gợi ý, dấu hiệu chưa chắc chắn
items.explanation: hint /hɪnt/ (danh từ): gợi ý, dấu hiệu chưa chắc chắn. "Treat it as a hint" = coi như gợi ý, chưa kết luận.
items.explanationEn: hint /hɪnt/ (noun): a weak sign, not proof. "Treat it as a hint" = do not treat it as proof.

items.question: Trong câu "Multiply roll rates along the chain and you get a rough forecast: of 100 loans that are 1–30 late today, about 35 reach 31–60, about 26 of those reach 61–90, and almost all of those reach 90+.", từ "forecast" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multiply roll rates along the chain and you get a rough forecast: of 100 loans that are 1–30 late today, about 35 reach 31–60, about 26 of those reach 61–90, and almost all of those reach 90+.", what does "forecast" (noun) mean?
options: báo cáo kết quả quá khứ
items.explanation: forecast /ˈfɔː.kɑːst/ (danh từ): dự báo. "A rough forecast" = dự báo sơ bộ.
items.explanationEn: forecast /ˈfɔː.kɑːst/ (noun): an estimate of the future. "A rough forecast" = an approximate prediction.

items.question: Trong câu "Here 35 of the 68 loans that were 1–30 days delinquent (about 51%) cured in June, but only 4 of 20 from 31–60.", từ "delinquent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Here 35 of the 68 loans that were 1–30 days delinquent (about 51%) cured in June, but only 4 of 20 from 31–60.", what does "delinquent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: delinquent /dɪˈlɪŋ.kwənt/ (tính từ): chậm trả, đang quá hạn. Danh từ: delinquency = tình trạng quá hạn.
items.explanationEn: delinquent /dɪˈlɪŋ.kwənt/ (adjective): behind on payments. Noun: delinquency.

items.question: Trong câu "Here 35 of the 68 loans that were 1–30 days delinquent (about 51%) cured in June, but only 4 of 20 from 31–60.", từ "cure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Here 35 of the 68 loans that were 1–30 days delinquent (about 51%) cured in June, but only 4 of 20 from 31–60.", what does "cure" (verb) mean?
options: quay về trong hạn (sau khi trả bù)
optionsEn: to roll to a worse bucket
to return to current after being late
items.explanation: cure /kjʊər/ (động từ): quay về trong hạn (sau khi trả bù). "Cure rate" = tỷ lệ khoản trễ quay về trong hạn.
items.explanationEn: cure /kjʊər/ (verb): to return to current after being late. "Cure rate" = share of late loans returning to current.

items.question: Trong câu "The full investigation is the case study in da-08.", từ "investigation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The full investigation is the case study in da-08.", what does "investigation" (noun) mean?
options: cuộc điều tra hình sự của công an
cuộc điều tra, phân tích tìm nguyên nhân
items.explanation: investigation /ɪnˌves.tɪˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): cuộc điều tra, phân tích tìm nguyên nhân. "Root-cause investigation" = điều tra nguyên nhân gốc.
items.explanationEn: investigation /ɪnˌves.tɪˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a careful search for causes. "Root-cause investigation" = finding the underlying cause.

items.question: Trong câu "Moving it is a trade-off: a lower cut-off approves more people and also more bad loans.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Moving it is a trade-off: a lower cut-off approves more people and also more bad loans.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: giving up one thing to get another
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "A trade-off between volume and risk" = đánh đổi giữa khối lượng và rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (noun): giving up one thing to get another. "A trade-off between volume and risk".

items.question: Trong câu "Moving to 680 cuts volume by two thirds for almost no further gain, and with only 5 bad loans the 0.9% is mostly noise.", từ "noise" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Moving to 680 cuts volume by two thirds for almost no further gain, and with only 5 bad loans the 0.9% is mostly noise.", what does "noise" (noun) mean?
options: biến động ngẫu nhiên, không có ý nghĩa
items.explanation: noise /nɔɪz/ (danh từ): biến động ngẫu nhiên, không có ý nghĩa. "Mostly noise" = phần lớn là ngẫu nhiên, mẫu quá nhỏ.
items.explanationEn: noise /nɔɪz/ (noun): random variation without meaning. "Mostly noise" = mostly random because the sample is small.

items.question: Trong câu "Moving to 680 cuts volume by two thirds for almost no further gain, and with only 5 bad loans the 0.9% is mostly noise.", từ "volume" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Moving to 680 cuts volume by two thirds for almost no further gain, and with only 5 bad loans the 0.9% is mostly noise.", what does "volume" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the amount or number of loans
items.explanation: volume /ˈvɒl.juːm/ (danh từ): khối lượng, số lượng (khoản vay). "Loan volume" = số khoản / số tiền cho vay.
items.explanationEn: volume /ˈvɒl.juːm/ (noun): the amount or number of loans. "Loan volume" = how much lending is done.

items.question: Trong câu "The honest way to learn about a lower cut-off is a small, controlled test, with the losses budgeted in advance.", từ "budget" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The honest way to learn about a lower cut-off is a small, controlled test, with the losses budgeted in advance.", what does "budget" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: budget /ˈbʌdʒ.ɪt/ (động từ): dự trù ngân sách cho. "Losses budgeted in advance" = khoản lỗ đã được dự trù.
items.explanationEn: budget /ˈbʌdʒ.ɪt/ (verb): to plan money for. "Losses budgeted in advance" = losses planned for.

items.question: Trong câu "The honest way to learn about a lower cut-off is a small, controlled test, with the losses budgeted in advance.", từ "in advance" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The honest way to learn about a lower cut-off is a small, controlled test, with the losses budgeted in advance.", what does "in advance" (phrase) mean?
options: trước (thời điểm sự việc xảy ra)
items.explanation: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (cụm từ): trước (thời điểm sự việc xảy ra). "Pay / plan in advance" = trả / lên kế hoạch trước.
items.explanationEn: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (phrase): beforehand. "Pay / plan in advance" = do it beforehand.

items.question: Trong câu "Watch the income field: it is self-declared, sometimes missing, and da-03 found typo values like 999,999,999 that would make anyone look affordable.", từ "self-declared" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Watch the income field: it is self-declared, sometimes missing, and da-03 found typo values like 999,999,999 that would make anyone look affordable.", what does "self-declared" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: stated by the customer, not verified
items.explanation: self-declared /ˌself.dɪˈkleəd/ (tính từ): do khách tự khai. Dữ liệu tự khai cần được kiểm tra trước khi dùng để chấm điểm.
items.explanationEn: self-declared /ˌself.dɪˈkleəd/ (adjective): stated by the customer, not verified. Self-declared data needs checking before it drives decisions.

items.question: Trong câu "Watch the income field: it is self-declared, sometimes missing, and da-03 found typo values like 999,999,999 that would make anyone look affordable.", từ "affordable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Watch the income field: it is self-declared, sometimes missing, and da-03 found typo values like 999,999,999 that would make anyone look affordable.", what does "affordable" (adjective) mean?
options: (khoản vay) vừa khả năng chi trả
items.explanation: affordable /əˈfɔː.də.bəl/ (tính từ): (khoản vay) vừa khả năng chi trả. Ở đây: thu nhập ảo khiến ai cũng trông "affordable".
items.explanationEn: affordable /əˈfɔː.də.bəl/ (adjective): within someone's means. Here: a fake income makes anyone look able to pay.

items.question: Trong câu "Young people and first-time borrowers are often thin-file, so a lender that wants to grow has to find other signals (wallet history, bill payments, a small first limit that grows with good behaviour).", từ "signal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Young people and first-time borrowers are often thin-file, so a lender that wants to grow has to find other signals (wallet history, bill payments, a small first limit that grows with good behaviour).", what does "signal" (noun) mean?
options: dấu hiệu, dữ liệu giúp dự đoán
items.explanation: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu, dữ liệu giúp dự đoán. "Alternative signals" = dữ liệu thay thế (ví, hóa đơn) để đánh giá khách.
items.explanationEn: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (noun): information that helps predict. "Alternative signals" = other data such as wallet or bill history.

items.question: Trong câu "The snapshot is distorted by its denominator: BNPL loans last 3–6 months, so good ones close quickly (887 BNPL loans are already closed) and leave behind a small open book where the bad loans are overrepresented.", từ "distorted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The snapshot is distorted by its denominator: BNPL loans last 3–6 months, so good ones close quickly (887 BNPL loans are already closed) and leave behind a small open book where the bad loans are overrepresented.", what does "distorted" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distorted /dɪˈstɔː.tɪd/ (tính từ): bị méo, sai lệch. "A distorted picture" = bức tranh bị bóp méo.
items.explanationEn: distorted /dɪˈstɔː.tɪd/ (adjective): giving a false picture. "A distorted picture" = a misleading view.

items.question: Trong câu "The snapshot is distorted by its denominator: BNPL loans last 3–6 months, so good ones close quickly (887 BNPL loans are already closed) and leave behind a small open book where the bad loans are overrepresented.", từ "overrepresented" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The snapshot is distorted by its denominator: BNPL loans last 3–6 months, so good ones close quickly (887 BNPL loans are already closed) and leave behind a small open book where the bad loans are overrepresented.", what does "overrepresented" (adjective) mean?
options: có quá nhiều người đại diện pháp lý
chiếm tỷ trọng lớn hơn thực tế
optionsEn: making up a bigger share than it should
items.explanation: overrepresented /ˌəʊ.vəˌrep.rɪˈzen.tɪd/ (tính từ): chiếm tỷ trọng lớn hơn thực tế. Trái nghĩa: underrepresented.
items.explanationEn: overrepresented /ˌəʊ.vəˌrep.rɪˈzen.tɪd/ (adjective): making up a bigger share than it should. Opposite: underrepresented.

items.question: Trong câu "Overdue amount ÷ book = (1 + 2 + 1) ÷ 20 = 20% here too, but only by coincidence; the two measure different things.", từ "coincidence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Overdue amount ÷ book = (1 + 2 + 1) ÷ 20 = 20% here too, but only by coincidence; the two measure different things.", what does "coincidence" (noun) mean?
options: sự thống nhất giữa hai team
items.explanation: coincidence /kəʊˈɪn.sɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): sự trùng hợp ngẫu nhiên. "Only by coincidence" = chỉ là trùng hợp.
items.explanationEn: coincidence /kəʊˈɪn.sɪ.dəns/ (noun): two things matching by chance. "Only by coincidence" = by chance.

items.question: Trong câu "A higher approval rate is not automatically good news.", từ "automatically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A higher approval rate is not automatically good news.", what does "automatically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: automatically /ˌɔː.təˈmæt.ɪ.kli/ (trạng từ): tất yếu, mặc nhiên. "Not automatically good" = không mặc nhiên là tốt.
items.explanationEn: automatically /ˌɔː.təˈmæt.ɪ.kli/ (adverb): necessarily, without question. "Not automatically good" = not necessarily good.

items.question: Trong câu "The loan book is measured by outstanding principal, not by total disbursed.", từ "measure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The loan book is measured by outstanding principal, not by total disbursed.", what does "measure" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to judge the size of something by
items.explanation: measure /ˈmeʒ.ər/ (động từ): đo lường, đánh giá bằng. "Measured by X" = được đo bằng X.
items.explanationEn: measure /ˈmeʒ.ər/ (verb): to judge the size of something by. "Measured by X" = sized by X.

items.question: Trong câu "Annuity installments are fixed, but early payments are mostly interest.", từ "fixed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Annuity installments are fixed, but early payments are mostly interest.", what does "fixed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fixed /fɪkst/ (tính từ): cố định, không đổi. "Fixed installment" = tiền trả cố định mỗi kỳ.
items.explanationEn: fixed /fɪkst/ (adjective): staying the same. "Fixed installment" = the same payment each month.

items.question: Trong câu "Buckets (1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+) drive collections work.", từ "drive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Buckets (1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+) drive collections work.", what does "drive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drive /draɪv/ (động từ): định hướng, quyết định. "Data drives decisions" = dữ liệu dẫn dắt quyết định.
items.explanationEn: drive /draɪv/ (verb): to determine or guide. "Data drives decisions".

items.question: Trong câu "In Vietnam, loans are classified into five debt groups by days overdue; check the current SBV circular for the rules.", từ "classify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In Vietnam, loans are classified into five debt groups by days overdue; check the current SBV circular for the rules.", what does "classify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: classify /ˈklæs.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): phân loại. "Classified into groups" = được phân vào nhóm.
items.explanationEn: classify /ˈklæs.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to sort into groups. "Classified into groups" = sorted into groups.

items.question: Trong câu "Vintage tables compare loans at the same MOB; blank cells are right-censored, not zero.", từ "blank" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Vintage tables compare loans at the same MOB; blank cells are right-censored, not zero.", what does "blank" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: blank /blæŋk/ (tính từ): để trống. Ô trống khác số 0: trống là chưa có dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: blank /blæŋk/ (adjective): empty, with nothing written. A blank cell is not zero: it means no data yet.

items.question: Trong câu "At MOB 2–3, the March and April 2026 vintages are clearly worse than earlier ones, which da-08 investigates.", từ "investigate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At MOB 2–3, the March and April 2026 vintages are clearly worse than earlier ones, which da-08 investigates.", what does "investigate" (verb) mean?
options: điều tra, tìm hiểu kỹ nguyên nhân
optionsEn: to examine carefully to find causes
items.explanation: investigate /ɪnˈves.tɪ.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): điều tra, tìm hiểu kỹ nguyên nhân. Đừng nhầm với "invest" (đầu tư).
items.explanationEn: investigate /ɪnˈves.tɪ.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to examine carefully to find causes. Do not confuse with "invest".

items.question: Trong câu "A lower cut-off buys volume at the price of more bad loans, and the bad rate below the old cut-off is unknown (reject inference).", từ "at the price of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A lower cut-off buys volume at the price of more bad loans, and the bad rate below the old cut-off is unknown (reject inference).", what does "at the price of" (phrase) mean?
options: với cái giá phải trả là
items.explanation: at the price of /æt ðə praɪs əv/ (cụm từ): với cái giá phải trả là. Nói về sự đánh đổi: được cái này, mất cái kia.
items.explanationEn: at the price of /æt ðə praɪs əv/ (phrase): by accepting the cost of. Describes a trade-off: you gain one thing by losing another.

items.question: Trong câu "Roll rates show how delinquent loans move between buckets; cures show how many come back.", từ "come back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Roll rates show how delinquent loans move between buckets; cures show how many come back.", what does "come back" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: come back /kʌm bæk/ (cụm từ): quay lại (trạng thái trong hạn). Ở đây: khoản trễ quay về trong hạn (cure).
items.explanationEn: come back /kʌm bæk/ (phrase): to return to normal. Here: a late loan returning to current (a cure).

items.question: Trong câu "Compare loan prices by APR, never by a flat monthly rate.", từ "price" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Compare loan prices by APR, never by a flat monthly rate.", what does "price" (noun) mean?
options: giá niêm yết của hàng hóa
items.explanation: price /praɪs/ (danh từ): chi phí vay (lãi và phí). "Loan price" = chi phí của khoản vay, nên so bằng APR.
items.explanationEn: price /praɪs/ (noun): the cost of borrowing. "Loan price" = the cost of the loan, best compared by APR.
